text_block_list.text:
Oh… You're in yet another special magazine
feature, nee-sama!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
(Mejiro Ramonu,
the first in history to win the Triple Tiara…
the pride of the Mejiro family… Fairest
Obisdian… the unbreakable Triple Tiara
Umamusume.)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(But for all the extravagant epithets they
bestow her… there's hardly anything written
about the radiance she commands.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Neither longing nor jealousy could ever hope
to draw even with my sister.
Truly… she is magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Perhaps she's testing me by having me go
in her stead this time.
Testing to see if I'm capable of standing
amongst these leviathans.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The question is whether my radiance could
ever match hers or not.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Naturally,
I shall not falter.
I shall not crumble! Come what may,
I will not give in until the performance is
complete!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone a radiance that 
will bring pride to my sister's name!

Looks like you all have gotten used to the
big brushes!
I think it's time we work on nailing down
the performance.
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
We're going to do the real thing in a gym,
but for now let's use all the space we have
on this field!
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
For the structure of the performance,
we'll divide it into two parts. First,
C.B. and Ace will write the first half.
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then, Maruzensky, Ardan,
and myself will do the last half,
and we'll conclude after we hang them up.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
'Aight, roger that! That means we're up first,
C.B… Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Here goes… hiyah!

Haha, looking good, Ace! Your movements 
look totally different from yesterday.
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
'Course they do!
No matter how high a wall ya put in front
of me,
I'll just knock it down and go straight to
the top!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's not just her movements,
but her writing looks bolder,
too! That girl's got guts for sure!

'Kay, time for the next character! You ready,
C.B.?!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
Hehe… hahaha! I've been ready! I'm having fun,
so much fun… ah,
I just can't hold it in anymore!
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, C.B.—
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: C'mon Ace, follow my lead!
A… a backflip?!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Gosh, talk about unexpected! But look, 
her handwriting's still so beautiful!
text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.text:
She's moving so boldly,
even though one mistake 
could cost her… how is she so composed?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Hey, I see you all over there!
Are you just gonna watch?
Don'tcha think that's boring?
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text: Your turn's up next. C'mon!
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
… Goodness, she's as zealous as ever. 
That capricious nature of hers hasn't changed
a bit.
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wow, talk about wiggin' out!
But that's why we're here,
isn't it? Let's give it a shot too, eh?

Hu-! 
Huup!
text_block_list.name: Maruzen & Rudolf

text_block_list.text: O-oh… gh…!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
(I-I musn't join in… right now,
the air between them is just… so…!)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Guys, guys… guys, guys, guys, guys, guys!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text: I swear, it's like herding cats…!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I really… froze up there, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Truthfully,
I came to practice today thinking 
I would be able to keep up with you all,
but…

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Geez, they're seriously somethin' else!
All those crazy moves and their writing was
still perfect.
They've got complete control over their
bodies and the brush.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
But hey, that's just how they are. 
The ceiling doesn't exist for 'em.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
They're the real strong ones. 
Always gettin' stronger with no end in
sight.
No end in sight, you say…
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
But that ain't all.
Tomorrow's a new day for us, Ardan!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
No matter where they go,
we'll give 'em chase!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text: You're right. That we shall, Ace-san!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
